name: Potion
desc: Restores a small amount of health.

name: Mega Potion
desc: Restores a moderate amount of health.

name: Antidote
desc: A cure for poison.

name: Max Potion
desc: Fully restores health and temporarily maximizes the size of your Health Gauge.

name: Ancient Potion
desc: Fully restores health and temporarily maximizes the size of your Health and Stamina Gauges.

name: Nulberry
desc: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

name: Ration
desc: Food that restores a bit of stamina. It can also be used on the Portable BBQ Grill to have a meal.

name: Well-done Steak
desc: A hearty roast that restores health and stamina and boosts both their max gauges. So tasty!

name: Rare Steak
desc: Restores health and stamina and moderately increases the size of your Health Gauge temporarily.

name: Burnt Meat
desc: Restores stamina, but it may be a bit too charred to provide any healing effects...

name: Lifepowder
desc: Produces a cloud that heals you and anyone nearby.

name: Raw Meat
desc: Meat carved from a monster. Can be cooked, combined,  or used to set a trap.

name: Barrel Bomb
desc: A small time bomb.

name: Large Barrel Bomb
desc: A bomb that can be rolled after placing it on the ground. Strike it to trigger a powerful blast.

name: Flash Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that causes a violent flash on impact. Will temporarily blind monsters if used in front of them.

name: Stone
desc: Slinger ammo that can be used to hit faraway plant life and bombs.

name: Capture Net
desc: A net that can be fired from your Slinger. Use it to capture small creatures.

name: Pitfall Trap
desc: A trap for catching large monsters. It is tripped by heavy weight.

name: Shock Trap
desc: A trap that immobilizes a target. Use it to capture monsters.

name: Whetstone
desc: A standard-sized whetstone. Use it to restore a weapon's sharpness.

name: Binoculars
desc: A tool that magnifies distant objects and lets you learn more about them.

name: Camping Kit
desc: A kit with all the tools to make camp. Use to set up and edit Pop-up Camps in available campsites.

name: Portable BBQ Grill
desc: A portable BBQ grill that can be used for grilling up raw meat and other ingredients.

name: Herb
desc: A primary ingredient in potions.

name: Antidote Herb
desc: A primary ingredient in antidotes.

name: Honey
desc: Highly nutritious honey. Combine with potions to make the more potent mega potion.

name: Bitterbug Broth
desc: Bitterbug essence that has innate healing abilities. Used as a component in many medicines.

name: Flashbug Phosphor
desc: Luminous essence from an insect that emits a powerful flash when it dies. Used to craft flash pods.

name: Godbug Essence
desc: Essence from an insect said to live a millennium. Combine it with other items to add their properties.

name: Thunderbug Capacitor
desc: Substance from an insect that emits electricity when struck. Required to craft Shock Traps and Thunder Ammo.

name: Doshaguma Hide
desc: A Doshaguma hide. The numerous scars on its body are proof of its beastly, aggressive nature.

name: Doshaguma Fur
desc: Doshaguma fur. It makes a durable crafting material thanks to its stiff, bristly texture.

name: Doshaguma Claw
desc: A Doshaguma claw. Sharp as it is tough, it can cut through muscled prey without a single chip.

name: Doshaguma Fang
desc: A Doshaguma fang. They grow large and sharp so they can pierce their prey with ease.

name: Beast Gem
desc: A valuable jewel formed from coagulated juices inside a monster. Glows wildly.

name: Normal Ammo
desc: Standard ammo. Fires multiple shots with each pull of the trigger. Unlimited capacity.

name: Pierce Ammo
desc: Armor-piercing ammo. Depending on the monster, it can deal multiple hits. Unlimited capacity.

name: Spread Ammo
desc: Ammo made for close combat. Short range but high power. Unlimited capacity.

name: Sticky Ammo
desc: Powerful ammo that lodges in a target and explodes. Headshots stun.

name: Cluster Bomb
desc: Ammo that fragments into multiple shells upon impact. Beware of friendly fire!

name: Flaming Ammo
desc: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to fire.

name: Water Ammo
desc: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to water.

name: Thunder Ammo
desc: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to thunder.

name: Freeze Ammo
desc: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to ice.

name: Dragon Ammo
desc: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters weak to dragon.

name: Poison Ammo
desc: Ammo that inflicts poison. Some targets require multiple shots in order for the status to take effect.

name: Paralysis Ammo
desc: Ammo that causes paralysis. Some targets require multiple shots in order for the status to take effect.

name: Sleep Ammo
desc: Ammo that induces sleep. Some targets require multiple shots in order for the status to take effect.

name: Slicing Ammo
desc: Ammo that ejects sharp blades on impact, which can sever tails.

name: Thorngrass Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that lodges into a target. Attacking where it's lodged deals extra damage.

name: Iron Ore
desc: Ore that can be smelted into a multi-purpose metal.

name: Machalite Ore
desc: Ore mined from mineral veins. Refined Machalite Steel is far sturdier than its iron cousin.

name: Dragonite Ore
desc: Ore sourced from mining outcrops. A rare material coveted for its durability in armor crafting.

name: Carbalite Ore
desc: Ore obtained from mining outcrops. Still under research, but known to yield highly pure metal.

name: Earth Crystal
desc: Crystallized microbes sourced from mining outcrops. Coveted as an abrasive for polishing equipment.

name: Mystery Bone
desc: A weathered bone taken from a bonepile. Erosion has left it too fragile to use in crafting.

name: Sturdy Bone
desc: A rigid bone taken from a bonepile. Durable but light and easy to handle.

name: Brute Bone
desc: A sturdy bone from a beast. Easy to use in crafting.

name: Colossal Bone
desc: A massive bone from a beast. Carefully cut out and used for crafting.

name: Dragonbone Relic
desc: A high-quality bone taken from a bonepile. The remains of a dragon that once roamed these lands.

name: Mandragora
desc: A dangerous fungus said to draw the life out of people. Required to craft immunizers and max potions.

name: Blue Mushroom
desc: A mushroom infused with power-enhancing effects. Used in restorative items.

name: Burst Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that detonates on impact. Use it to stagger a monster when you're in a pinch.

name: Screamer Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that emits a harsh, high-frequency sound that can disrupt sensitive monsters.

name: Bleeding Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that can be used to inflict massive damage on monster wounds.

name: Dung Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that releases a strong odor on impact. Causes certain monsters to flee.

name: Trap Tool
desc: A must-have item for putting together pitfall traps and shock traps.

name: Exciteshroom
desc: Has a very strange aroma. Is it edible? Is it deadly? Required to make farcasters.

name: Smokenut
desc: A nut that produces torrents of smoke. Combine with other items to add more effects.

name: Ivy
desc: A lightweight and extremely strong plant. Used to make nets for pitfall traps.

name: Farcaster
desc: Call for a wingdrake to transport you to the nearest camp. Can also be used during combat.

name: Balahara Shell
desc: A Balahara shell. The fulgurite it has absorbed enhances its hardness.

name: Balahara Scale
desc: A Balahara scale. The erosion caused by constant digging limits its usefulness in crafting.

name: Balahara Skull
desc: The skull of a Balahara. Stronger than most, it's built to withstand harsh dives into sand.

name: Balahara Tail
desc: A Balahara tail. Its unique, twisted shape allows it to propel itself through earth with great force.

name: Chatacabra Jaw
desc: The mandible plating of a Chatacabra. Hard protrusions stud the thick but supple leather.

name: Chatacabra Hide
desc: The thick hide of a Chatacabra. Elastic and easy to mold thanks to the monster's gluttonous diet.

name: Chatacabra Shell
desc: Plating that covers a Chatacabra's forelimbs. A lifetime of licking has left it both smooth and sturdy.

name: Chatacabra Scale
desc: A jagged scale from a Chatacabra's hide, especially tough and well suited for use in crafting armor.

name: Quematrice Scale
desc: The scale of a Quematrice. Its fine texture acts as a natural file used to grind and polish armor.

name: Quematrice Hide
desc: The hide of a Quematrice. Quite thick despite its wrinkly form, it is highly resistant to fire.

name: Quematrice Crest
desc: The crest of a Quematrice. Its flamboyant red color serves as a decoy to would-be predators.

name: Quematrice Tail
desc: The tail of a Quematrice. Its many pleats scrape against each other to create sparks.

name: Wyvern Gem
desc: Throughout a wyvern's life, impurities gather and form this peculiar gem.

name: Herbivore Shell
desc: Part of a shell taken from an herbivore. Relatively sturdy for a small monster material.

name: Bulaqchi Shell
desc: A Bulaqchi shell. Great for crafting thanks to its advanced durability and light weight.

name: Talioth Scale
desc: A Talioth scale. Conditioned in harsh environments, it is built to protect the body like armor.

name: Sharp Fang
desc: Fangs come in many shapes and sizes. Choose the right fang for the job.

name: Wingdrake Hide
desc: A material carved from wingdrakes. Lightweight and often used when crafting armor.

name: Acute Fang
desc: Fangs come in many shapes and sizes. This one is small but can still pierce scale.

name: Dung
desc: Its eye-watering stench makes useful Slinger ammo.

name: Rolled-up Dung
desc: A ball of condensed monster dung. Used to make dung pods for your Slinger.

name: Rathian Scale+
desc: A superior Rathian scale. Looks like a normal Rathian scale but is much harder.

name: Rathian Carapace
desc: Rathian carapace prized for its lavish green coloration. An excellent armor material.

name: Rathian Webbing
desc: A quality Rathian wing membrane. This heat-resistant material is often used as armor lining.

name: Rathian Spike+
desc: Rathian hairs, keen as a sword. Longer and sturdier than normal, they also contain more poison.

name: Rathian Ruby
desc: A rare, precious gem from inside a Rathian. Almost too nice to use.

name: Toadstool
desc: A mushroom with poison properties. Needed to craft Poison Ammo and smoke bombs.

name: Parashroom
desc: A mushroom that induces paralysis. Needed to craft Paralysis Ammo and tranq bombs.

name: Sleep Herb
desc: A plant containing sleeping agents. Needed to craft Sleep Ammo and tranq bombs.

name: Fire Herb
desc: A wondrous, flammable plant. Useful for crafting explosives and Flaming Ammo.

name: Flowfern
desc: This plant's leaves store a great amount of water. A component for making Water Ammo.

name: Snow Herb
desc: A plant that radiates ice-cold air. Use in combinations to create Freeze Ammo.

name: Dragonfell Berry
desc: A mysterious berry rumored for eons to be loathed by dragons. Required to craft Dragon Ammo.

name: First-aid Med
desc: Restores a small amount of health. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Ration
desc: Restores a small amount of stamina. Not usable with Portable BBQ Grill. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Flash Bomb
desc: Slinger ammo that explodes with a bright flash after it's fired. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Shock Trap
desc: A trap that immobilizes a target. Use it to capture monsters. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Pitfall Trap
desc: Activates a pitfall to catch monsters with. Returned after quest completion.

name: Gloamgrass Bud
desc: A plant with healing properties. Combine with Godbug essence to unleash its true potential.

name: Might Seed
desc: Temporarily strengthens your attacks when ingested by improving energy flow.

name: Adamant Seed
desc: Temporarily raises your defense when ingested by hardening tissue.

name: Nitroshroom
desc: A hard-to-find mushroom with the power to generate blazing heat. Required to craft gunpowder.

name: Devil's Blight
desc: A very rare fungus that pulses with extreme heat. Add to a barrel bomb for a dramatically stronger blast.

name: Blastnut
desc: A nut that explodes its hard contents on impact. Used to make Sticky Ammo.

name: Slashberry
desc: A berry that shatters into razor-like pieces. Used to make Slicing Ammo.

name: Rey Dau Scale
desc: A Rey Dau scale. Its unique shape allows electricity from its organs to pass through.

name: Rey Dau Shell
desc: The shell from a Rey Dau. Highly conductive and capable of producing large electrical currents.

name: Rey Dau Thunderhorn
desc: An electrically charged Rey Dau horn. The thick, flexible muscle at its base lets it move freely.

name: Rey Dau Wingtalon
desc: The claw-shaped energy conduit of a Rey Dau. Coated in sharp fulgurite blades formed by electric discharges.

name: Rey Dau Tail
desc: A Rey Dau tail. Its fulgurite- covered spines rub together to produce a threatening melody.

name: Rey Dau Plate
desc: A Rey Dau plate. The backward- facing scale accumulates a massive amount of energy.

name: Tranq Blade
desc: A knife coated with a tranquilizer that can be shot from your Slinger to put trapped monsters to sleep.

name: Smoke Bomb
desc: Creates a large cloud of smoke when thrown against the ground that can hide you from a monster's sight.

name: Powercharm
desc: An amulet that strengthens attacks. Just carrying this gives you demonic strength.

name: Armorcharm
desc: An amulet that increases defense. Just carrying this makes your skin stone hard.

name: Wyvern Ammo
desc: Ammo created through years of research into Wyvern's Fire. Short ranged, but destructive.

name: Grounding Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that can dissipate electricity from the area it lands.

name: Mystery Orb - Armor
desc: A sphere with faint power that is revealed through appraisal. Becomes a defensive decoration.

name: Glowing Orb - Armor
desc: A sphere with hidden power that is revealed through appraisal. Becomes a defensive decoration.

name: Ancient Orb - Armor
desc: A sphere with incredible power that is revealed through appraisal. Becomes a defensive decoration.

name: Damaged Weapon Shard
desc: An old, damaged weapon part. Needs to be appraised.

name: Rusted Weapon Shard
desc: An old, rusted weapon part. Needs to be appraised.

name: Ghillie Mantle
desc: Temporarily conceal yourself from view. The effect ends if you perform an attack or take damage.

name: Fishing Rod
desc: A tool for fishing. Cast the lure into bodies of water and use the reel to wind in the line.

name: Energy Drink
desc: A Guild-approved beverage that boosts your stamina. Helps shake off sleep, too!

name: Dash Juice
desc: Recovers stamina and also temporarily reduces stamina depletion when performing actions.

name: Immunizer
desc: Temporarily boosts your natural ability to recover lost health.

name: Cool Drink
desc: Provides temporary relief from extreme heat.

name: Hot Drink
desc: Provides temporary relief from extreme cold.

name: Demondrug
desc: Temporarily boosts your attack power by filling you with demonic strength.

name: Might Pill
desc: Temporarily endows you with the strength of a mighty god. Potent!

name: Mega Demondrug
desc: Temporarily boosts your attack power even more than a regular Demondrug.

name: Armorskin
desc: Temporarily boosts your defense by turning your skin as hard as rock.

name: Adamant Pill
desc: Temporarily makes your skin as hard as adamant. Potent!

name: Mega Armorskin
desc: Temporarily boosts your defense even more than regular Armorskin.

name: Herbal Medicine
desc: Removes all traces of poison and restores a slight amount of health.

name: Herbal Powder
desc: Produces a cloud that cures poison and heals you a bit.

name: Demon Powder
desc: A mysterious powder that produces a cloud around the area that temporarily strengthens attacks.

name: Hardshell Powder
desc: A mysterious powder; when dispersed, temporarily strengthens defense.

name: Dust of Life
desc: Produces a cloud that restores a large amount of health for you and anyone nearby.

name: Cleanser
desc: Immediately removes any frost or webbing on your body.

name: Poison Smoke Bomb
desc: Releases a cloud of toxic mist when used. Also popular as a household bug bomb.

name: Tranq Bomb
desc: A hand grenade used to capture monsters ensnared in traps. Can be slammed against the ground.

name: Throwing Knife
desc: A knife that can be equipped to your Slinger. Can be coated with a range of substances.

name: Poison Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that inflicts  poison on a target upon  impact.

name: Para Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that inflicts paralysis on a target upon impact.

name: Drugged Meat
desc: Raw meat that puts whatever eats it to sleep. Makes great bait for traps.

name: Brightmoss
desc: Slinger ammo that illuminates dark areas when fired and can dazzle flying monsters.

name: Torch Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that can be used to scare away creatures that don't like fire and draw in those that do.

name: Puddle Pod
desc: Slinger ammo imbued with water element. Can remove some statuses on monsters.

name: Bomb Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that explodes on impact.

name: Piercing Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that deals piercing damage on impact.

name: Paint Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that makes a monster or location temporarily easier to find.

name: Luring Pod
desc: Slinger ammo that can be used to lure monsters toward yourself.

name: Mega Barrel Bomb
desc: An upgraded large barrel bomb. Effective against large monsters. Can be rolled after placement.

name: First-aid Med+
desc: Restores a moderate amount of health. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Max Potion
desc: Fully restores health and maximizes the size of your Health Gauge. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Lifepowder
desc: Produces a cloud that heals you and anyone nearby. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Herbal Powder
desc: Cures poison and restores a bit of health for everyone nearby. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Demon Powder
desc: Temporarily strengthens attacks for everyone nearby. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Hardshell Powder
desc: Temporarily increases defense for everyone nearby. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Dust of Life
desc: Releases a cloud that restores a large amount of health. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Tranq Bomb
desc: A hand grenade used to capture monsters ensnared in traps. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Dung Pod
desc: Releases a strong odor on impact. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Sonic Bomb
desc: Slinger ammo that emits an earsplitting sonic blast. Returned after quest completion.

name: Tinged Meat
desc: Raw meat that paralyzes whatever eats it. Makes great bait for traps.

name: EZ Large Barrel Bomb
desc: An improved large barrel bomb. Can be rolled after being placed. Returned after quest completion.

name: EZ Farcaster
desc: Call for a wingdrake to transport you to the nearest camp. Returned after quest completion.

name: Poisoned Meat
desc: Raw meat that poisons whatever eats it. Makes great bait for traps.

name: Deodorant
desc: Produces a cloud of cleansing smoke that cures blastblight and stench.

name: Kunafa Cheese
desc: An artisan cheese made in Kunafa, deliciously gooey when heated, and a great addition to any dish.

name: Sharp Kunafa Cheese
desc: A rich, decadent cheese made by skilled craftspeople. A great addition to any dish.

name: Droolshroom
desc: A mushroom that grows in a secret spot known only to Wudwuds. A great addition to any dish.

name: Delishroom
desc: An extremely rare delicacy that is cause for a Wudwud celebration. A great addition to any dish.

name: Mud Shrimp
desc: A nutritious shrimp native to Oilwell Basin and favored in Azuz. A great addition to any dish.

name: Turbid Shrimp
desc: A large, chewy shrimp packed to the gills with nutrients. A great addition to any dish.

name: Fluffy Egg
desc: An egg with a yolk and white as fluffy as the Downy Crake that laid it. A great addition to any dish.

name: Airy Egg
desc: A high-quality egg that sends you straight to flavor heaven. A great addition to any dish.

name: Sild Garlic
desc: A highly nutritious and fragrant bulb of garlic grown in Sild. A great addition to any dish.

name: Specialty Sild Garlic
desc: The ultimate bulb of garlic, grown in just the right conditions. A great addition to any dish.

name: Wild Herb
desc: This herb's refreshing aroma can mask any foul odor. A great finishing touch to any dish.

name: Eastern Honey
desc: Has a unique flavor, making it the perfect secret ingredient. A great finishing touch to any dish.

name: Monster Chili
desc: A powerful spice that enhances flavor and sweat production. A great finishing touch to any dish.

name: Jeweled Mullet Roe
desc: These fish eggs truly shine like diamonds. A great finishing touch to any dish.

name: Wild Seed Oil
desc: Oil that packs both flavor and the power of nature. A great finishing touch to any dish.

name: Truffle Du Conga
desc: Often dug up by its namesake, Congalala. A great finishing touch to any dish.

name: Sinister Cloth
desc: Suspicious cloth found somewhere in the Windward Plains. Drips with an aura of pure evil.

name: Great Hornfly
desc: Found in the Scarlet Forest. An insect with a giant horn, huge shell, and butterfly wings.

name: Windward Aloe
desc: Found in the Windward Plains. The water stored within its plump leaves has saved many a parched traveler.

name: Fine Windward Aloe
desc: A rarity from the Windward Plains. A single drop of its delicious sap transforms water into ambrosia.

name: Great Windward Aloe
desc: A treasure of the Windward Plains. Its leaves hold enough water to fill a bath in the driest desert.

name: Sandpepper
desc: Found in the Windward Plains. This dried spice lends a rich and aromatic heat to any dish.

name: Fiery Sandpepper
desc: A rarity from the Windward Plains. A spice so hot that a single bite opens the taster's third eye.

name: Fulgurite Shard
desc: Found in the Windward Plains. The shape of this fulgurite was sculpted by a chance lightning strike.

name: Pure Fulgurite
desc: A rarity from the Windward Plains. Crystallized fulgurite, free of any impurity. Extremely delicate.

name: Thundering Fulgurite
desc: A treasure of the Windward Plains. A colossal fulgurite crystal, born of a sky-splitting thunderstrike.

name: Scarlet Amber Shard
desc: Amber from the Scarlet Forest. The bodies of fossilized insects float in its scarlet confines.

name: Fine Scarlet Amber
desc: Rare amber from the Scarlet Forest. Immaculate insect specimens sleep in this amber, red as fine liquor.

name: Eternal Scarlet Amber
desc: Colossal amber from the Scarlet Forest. Ancient life has been sealed away inside it for eons.

name: Queensbloom Pollen
desc: Pollen from a giant flower in the Scarlet Forest, as regal as it is massive. Makes a heady perfume.

name: Shiny Treasure
desc: An ancient artifact Wudwuds found in the Scarlet Forest. Purely aesthetic in nature.

name: Sparkly Treasure
desc: A rarity of the Scarlet Forest. The fine detail and lavish use of gold show quite advanced techniques.

name: Bulky Treasure
desc: The sheer scale of this Scarlet Forest rarity makes it the object of obsession for all Wudwuds.

name: Auric Oil
desc: Exceptionally pure, golden mineral oil from Oilwell Basin. Used widely in Flameborn crafts.

name: Antimite
desc: A mineral from Oilwell Basin with a unique sheen. Used by the Flameborn in alloy production.

name: Fine Antimite
desc: An Oilwell Basin rarity too pure to be worked by any but the Flameborn artisans.

name: Antimite Mass
desc: A hulking antimite formation that produces strange reactions not yet understood by science.

name: Hirabami Molting
desc: Skin shed from a Hirabami. Treasured by the people of the Iceshard Cliffs as a curative.

name: Wyvernscale Vase
desc: An ancient ornamental vase found in the Iceshard Cliffs. The techniques used to craft it are lost to time.

name: Dragonscale Vase
desc: Each individual scale ornamenting this vase from the Iceshard Cliffs sparkles with a fiery brilliance.

name: Large Goldenscale Vase
desc: An exquisite, inscribed vase from the Iceshard Cliffs. A treasure worthy of kings, lost to the world.

name: Wyveria Lantern
desc: Fruit encased in a mesh shell, found in the Ruins of Wyveria. A precious source of sustenance to the natives.

name: Mature Wyveria Lantern
desc: A rarity in the Ruins of Wyveria. The ripening process imbues the fruit with medicinal properties.

name: Origin Wylk Gem
desc: A precious find from the Ruins of Wyveria. More transparent than other Wylkdrops and has considerable heft.

name: Milky Cocoon Web
desc: A curious fiber found in the Ruins of Wyveria. A resource treasured by the Keepers.

name: Wylk Pebble
desc: Small stones found across the East. A rich source of energy, they are often burned for fuel.

name: Wylk Gem
desc: A beautiful, faintly luminescent stone occasionally found inside Wylkdrops harvested in the East.

name: Time-honed Wylk Gem
desc: The size of this rare find from the East is the result of an eons- long natural formation process.

name: Ancient Fossil
desc: The blackened, stony remains of old bones unearthed in the East. When polished, it gains a velvety sheen.

name: Drifting Sea Pot
desc: A species of translucent sea squirts found in the East. When salt-dried, it becomes a fine preserved food.

name: Royal Sea Pot
desc: A rare, meatier species of sea squirt found in the East. Keeps its rich flavor, even when preserved.

name: Gobletweed
desc: Algae that grows in the East. It resembles a ceremonial cup— Cheers for finding such a beauty!

name: Chaliceweed
desc: Care must be taken not to disturb the delicate form of this rare and stunning algae when harvesting it.

name: Nightflower Pollen
desc: Pollen from a flower that blooms under a full moon. It exudes an ethereal pale glow.

name: Fossilized Opal
desc: A mass of organic material fossilized into opal over time. It has a deep crimson shine.

name: Fossilized Fire Opal
desc: This gorgeous fossil is marked by an exceptionally clear and fiery opal. A truly radiant rarity.

name: Genesis Opal
desc: The opal inclusion in this fossil burns with the fire of creation that first shaped this world.

name: Wyvernsprout
desc: A parasitic fungus that grows on the bodies of dead monsters. Prized as a symbol of reincarnation.

name: Whetfish Fin
desc: A fish fin that greatly restores sharpness and requires fewer strokes than a whetstone.

name: Sushifish Scale
desc: A scale from a Sushifish. Slightly restores health and treats bleeding.

name: Lala Barina Shell
desc: The outer shell of a Lala Barina. Has a dark luster and is wonderfully lightweight.

name: Lala Barina Claw
desc: A claw from a Lala Barina. Vivid scarlet decorates its keen edge.

name: Lala Barina Stinger
desc: The stinger from a Lala Barina. Sharp as a sword, one thrust is all it takes to subdue prey.

name: Lala Barina Certificate
desc: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Lala Barina. Used to make equipment.

name: Lala Barina Floret
desc: Hair from a Lala Barina. So white and pristine that it could pass for a high quality pelt.

name: Screamer Pod
desc: Used as ammo for your Slinger. Emits a harsh, high-frequency sound that can disrupt sensitive monsters.

desc: Copper pyrite from a Kranodath's shell. Its luster makes it a prime material for decorations.

desc: High-quality copper pyrite from a Kranodath's shell. Its brilliant sheen is stunning to behold.

desc: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Gypceros. Used to make equipment.

name: Bird Wyvern Gem
desc: A valuable gem that can be harvested from bird wyverns. Said to fetch a high price on the market.

name: Dash Extract
desc: A mysterious substance culled from certain monsters that increases endurance.

name: Rathian Certificate S
desc: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Rathian. Used to make equipment.

name: Blangonga Pelt+
desc: Fine fur from a Blangonga. Its springy resilience and warmth make it prized in cold regions.

name: Blangonga Fang+
desc: A Blangonga canine. As large as a human thigh, it's basically a weapon already.

name: Blangonga Whisker
desc: A glorious mustache is the mark and pride of a Blangonga leader, a symbol of its might.

name: Blangonga Tail
desc: The tail of a Blangonga. The silky, lustrous coat is heavenly to the touch.

name: Blangonga Certificate S
desc: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Blangonga. Used to make equipment.

name: Gravios Carapace
desc: The sturdy carapace of a Gravios. Fused with ore by intense heat, it has grown abnormally tough.

name: Gravios Skull
desc: The head armor of a Gravios, hardened by its own heat. Makes it hard to work with, too.

name: Gravios Pleura+
desc: Shell that covers a Gravios's torso. It's grown so thick over time that average attacks do nothing to it.

name: Gravios Medulla
desc: Though hard to extract and hard to craft, the brain stem is an especially precious Gravios part.

name: Gravios Wing
desc: The hefty wing of a Gravios. Recently, the demand and value of the material has been rising.

name: Gravios Certificate S
desc: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Gravios. Used to make equipment.

name: Rathalos Scale+
desc: An extraordinarily durable scale carved from the body of a Rathalos.

name: Rathalos Carapace
desc: This Rathalos carapace emanates a nobility befitting the King of the Skies.

name: Rathalos Wing
desc: The wing of a Rathalos. Skilled artisans can craft it into strong equipment.

name: Rathalos Tail
desc: A severed Rathalos tail covered in plates and keen spines. It has any number of uses.

name: Rathalos Ruby
desc: A rare, precious gem from inside a Rathalos. Almost too nice to use.

name: Rathalos Certificate S
desc: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Rathalos. Used to make equipment.

name: Gore Magala Scale+
desc: A deep black scale that seems to devour surrounding light, not reflect it.

name: Gore Magala Carapace
desc: The Gore Magala's handsome black suit of armor, said to negate all blows.

name: Gore Magala Wing+
desc: A horrifying wing that casts a hungry shadow over prey and drives them insane.

name: Gore Magala Ripclaw+
desc: A claw from a Gore Magala's second foreleg. It inflicts Frenzy and generations of suffering.

name: Gore Magala Tail
desc: A pliant tail covered in reverse scales that strikes like a whip, not a blade.

name: Gore Magala Feeler+
desc: A well-honed sensory organ from a Gore Magala that oozes violet melancholy from its infected tip.

name: Gore Magala Nyctgem
desc: A pure, jet-black jewel that imprisons and swallows all nearby light.

name: Gore Magala Certificate S
desc: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Gore Magala. Used to make equipment.

name: Frenzy Crystal
desc: An unsettling crystal wreathed in Frenzied power. Handle with extreme care.

name: Conga Pelt
desc: A Conga pelt. Sturdy and soft to the touch but must be deodorized before it's processed.

name: Conga Pelt+
desc: A high-quality Conga pelt. The thick fur can be used to make long-lasting equipment.

name: Vespoid Shell
desc: A Vespoid shell. If processed correctly, it can become just as tough as a wyvern's hide.

name: Vespoid Carapace
desc: The hard carapace of a Vespoid. It takes on a unique quality once processed.

name: Vespoid Wing
desc: The wing of a Vespoid. Extremely difficult to process and produces widely varying results.

name: Vespoid Innerwing
desc: The innerwing of a Vespoid. Sharp and elegant, like a blade.

name: Blango Pelt+
desc: A high-quality Blango pelt. Difficult to process, but valuable nonetheless.

name: Lightcrystal
desc: A precious and extremely hard substance with a faint glow. Sometimes used for crafting tools.

name: Novacrystal
desc: High quality Lightcrystal. Highly coveted for its rarity, it's used for only the finest of metalworking.

name: Firestone
desc: Ore that is scorching even at room temperature. Its heat can be used to fuse materials.

name: Firecell Stone
desc: A magma-like deposit that only trained hands can handle. Armor made from it is first-class.

name: Fucium Ore
desc: A mysterious metal found in the Ruins of Wyveria, capable of fusing any other materials together.

name: Icium
desc: Precious metal from the Iceshard Cliffs. Shines bright white when the light catches it.

name: Guardian Fulgur Certificate S
desc: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Guardian Fulgur Anjanath. Used to make equipment.

name: Congalala Certificate S
desc: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Congalala. Used to make equipment.

name: Charred Oilbone
desc: A bone found in the Oilwell Basin. Covered in a thick coat of oil that built up over many years.

name: Frozen Icebone
desc: A bone found in the Iceshard Cliffs. Tempered over millennia deep within the frozen earth.

name: Tough Guardian Bone
desc: A bone found in the Ruins of Wyveria. Its peculiar shape is unique to the local wildlife.

name: Quality Bone
desc: A bone used as crafting material. Its ease of use and hardness allow it to be shaped into better gear.

name: Crushed Crystal
desc: A shard of crystal carved from the carcass of a Guardian. Can be used as a melding material.

name: Cloudy Crystal
desc: A hazy crystal carved from the carcass of a Guardian. Can be used as a melding material.

name: Coruscating Crystal
desc: A glittering crystal carved from the carcass of a Guardian. Can be used as a melding material.

name: Flame Sac
desc: A monster organ filled with flammable powder. Handle with extreme care.

name: Inferno Sac
desc: A monster organ filled with powder that ignites if it so much as touches air. Danger!

name: Aqua Sac
desc: A monster organ designed to hold and preserve water.

name: Torrent Sac
desc: A monster organ designed to hold and preserve copious amounts of water.

name: Thunder Sac
desc: A monster organ that can store up large amounts of high voltage electricity.

name: Frost Sac
desc: A monster organ filled with extremely cold fluid. Handle with care.

name: Freezer Sac
desc: A monster organ with tremendous chilling power. Flash-freezes its surroundings.

name: Poison Sac
desc: A monster organ filled with a lethal toxin. Handle with extreme care.

name: Toxin Sac
desc: A monster organ filled with an extremely potent toxin. Even one touch can be risky.

name: Lala Barina Mucus
desc: Body fluid from a Lala Barina. A sticky, red liquid that causes paralysis.

name: Lala Barina Mucus+
desc: Thick body fluid from a Lala Barina. As red as fresh blood, it contains a powerful paralytic.

name: Sleep Sac
desc: A monster organ filled with a knockout powder capable of inducing sleep.

name: Coma Sac
desc: A monster organ filled with a dangerous powder. One whiff can induce a coma.

name: Guardian Blood
desc: Guardian blood containing an unknown substance. A valuable research material.

name: Guardian Blood+
desc: Guardian blood with rather peculiar properties. Requires further research.

name: Great Hibiscus
desc: A large, brightly colored flower found in the Ruins of Wyveria. Spreads its seeds through the air.

name: Dalthydon Wool
desc: A product of Kunafa. Perfectly suited for desert life. Try bringing it to the Smithy.

name: Azuz Tanned Leather
desc: A product of Azuz. The leather is repeatedly repaired for extended use. Try taking it to the Smithy.

name: Suja Textiles
desc: A product of Suja. Its unique pattern has roots in Wyverian tradition. Try taking it to the Smithy.

name: Sild Cotton
desc: A product of Sild. A high-quality material that can be used as-is. Try bringing it to the Smithy.

name: Gajau Hide
desc: The hide of a Gajau. Covered in a thick slime that grants water resistance.

name: Speartuna Fin
desc: The sharp fin of a Speartuna. Might be useful for something if you bring it to the Smithy.

name: Commission Ticket
desc: A ticket in the image of a hunter who traveled to the New World. Try taking it to the Smithy.

name: Mimiphyta Ticket
desc: A ticket depicting the ecology of Mimiphyta. Give it to the Smithy to get special equipment.

name: Mystery Orb - Sword
desc: A sphere with faint power that is revealed through appraisal. Becomes an offensive decoration.

name: Glowing Orb - Sword
desc: A sphere with hidden power that can be revealed through appraisal. Becomes an offensive decoration.

name: Ancient Orb - Sword
desc: A sphere with incredible power that can be revealed through appraisal. Becomes an offensive decoration.

name: Armor Sphere
desc: Reacts uniquely to heat. Fuse this to armor to improve it by a tiny amount.

name: Armor Sphere+
desc: Reacts uniquely to heat. Fuse this to armor to improve it by a small amount.

name: Advanced Armor Sphere
desc: Reacts uniquely to heat. Fuse this to armor to improve it.

name: Hard Armor Sphere
desc: A rigid, high-density armor sphere. Fuse this to armor to improve it by a great amount.

name: Rocksteady Mantle
desc: Negates damage reactions, protects hearing, grants wind and tremor resistance, and reduces damage.

name: Mending Mantle
desc: Steadily restores health over a set amount of time.

name: Evasion Mantle
desc: Upon just evading a blow, triggers a special evasive maneuver that boosts attack and alters combos.

name: Corrupted Mantle
desc: Decreases health, but raises affinity and weapon stats. Attack and affinity further increased in certain conditions.

name: Wyvern Egg
desc: A flying wyvern's egg. Deliver it back to camp...if you can.

name: Charred Lizard
desc: A lizard charred crispy by Wudwuds. Removes all traces of poison and restores both health and stamina.

name: Wild Jerky
desc: Dried meat beloved for its wild flavor and toughness. Increases natural healing and cures bleeding.

name: Catalyst
desc: Works with other materials to enhance their effects. Cannot be used by itself.

name: Gunpowder
desc: A dangerous substance that explodes when struck or heated. Used in Large Barrel Bombs.

name: Small Barrel
desc: A small, empty barrel. Combine with fire herbs to make it into a bomb.

name: Large Barrel
desc: A large, empty barrel. Combine with gunpowder to make it into a bomb.

name: Spider Web
desc: A very sticky web. Used to craft pitfall traps.

name: Net
desc: A sturdy net that supports a certain amount of weight without breaking. Perfect for pitfall traps.

name: Gunpowderfish Scale
desc: A Gunpowderfish scale. Combine with a large barrel bomb to dramatically increase its firepower.

name: Burst Arowana Scale
desc: A Burst Arowana scale. Combine with Normal Ammo to make a large amount of Slicing Ammo.

name: Bomb Arowana Scale
desc: A Bomb Arowana scale. Combine with Normal Ammo to make a large amount of Sticky Ammo.

name: Gilded Scale
desc: A Goldenfry scale. Used by artisans in their crafts.

name: Golden Scale
desc: A Goldenfish scale. They shimmer like only pure gold can.

name: Platinum Scale
desc: A Platinumfish scale. They give off a beautiful gleam.

name: Steel Melding Ticket
desc: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding decorations to get a slight discount.

name: Silver Melding Ticket
desc: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding decorations to get a discount.

name: Steel Relic Ticket
desc: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding relics to get a slight discount.

name: Silver Relic Ticket
desc: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding relics to get a discount.

name: Steel Egg
desc: An egg of glittering steel. Rare but useless to hunters. Sells for a good price.

name: Silver Egg
desc: An egg of glittering silver. Rare but useless to hunters. Sells for a very good price.

name: Golden Egg
desc: An egg of glittering gold. Valuable but useless to hunters. Sells for a fortune.

name: Heavy Armor Sphere
desc: A solid, high-density armor sphere. Fuse this to armor to improve it by a vast amount.

name: Monster Keenbone
desc: Bone obtained from high-rank large monsters. It has a razor sharp tip that retains its strength after forging.

name: Monster Hardbone
desc: Precious bone obtained from high rank large monsters. Their rarity makes them highly sought after.

name: Stoutbone
desc: The bone of a large, high ranking monster. Very sturdy.

name: Great Stoutbone
desc: The bone of a large, high ranking monster. Extremely solid and durable.

name: Hunter Symbol I
desc: Proof that you've hunted a tempered monster, certifying your strength.

name: Hunter Symbol II
desc: Proof that you've hunted a fierce tempered monster, certifying your fearlessness.

name: Hunter Symbol III
desc: Proof that you've hunted a vicious tempered monster, certifying your heroism.

name: Gold Melding Ticket
desc: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding decorations to get a great discount.

name: Gold Relic Ticket
desc: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding relics to get a great discount.

name: Guardian Pelt
desc: Contains an unknown substance. It has lost any color it previously had and courses with energy.

name: Guardian Pelt+
desc: A high-quality Guardian pelt. Exceptionally smooth and tough.

name: Drearisite
desc: A mysterious material smelted in Azuz. Has been used to make equipment since ancient times.

name: Specklite
desc: A mysterious material smelted in Azuz. Not as pure as it could be, but still of impeccable quality.

name: Argecite
desc: A mysterious material smelted in Azuz. It's apparently primarily used in high-quality equipment.

name: Oricalcite
desc: A mysterious, high-quality material smelted in Azuz. Equipment made from it is second to none.

name: Common Wood Minnow
desc: A common wooden lure shaped like a small fish. Good for any kind of fish.

name: Golden Bughead
desc: A lure that looks like a shining beetle. Good for catching gaudy fish, like Goldenfish.

name: Emerald Jitterbait
desc: A lure with a blade made of ore. Good for catching useful fish, like Sushifish.

name: Tuff Joint Bait
desc: A lure shaped like a Cephalos. Good for catching large, swift fish, like Gastronome Tuna.

name: Duster Rig
desc: A lure shaped like a Starduster. Good for catching fish that like dark or muddy places, like Gajau.

name: Tentacle Jig
desc: A lure made with thorngrass. Good for catching aquatic creatures that have tentacles or feelers.

name: Close-range Coating
desc: A coating designed to deal more damage to nearby targets, at the cost of a reduced maximum range.

name: Power Coating
desc: A coating that increases the attack power of arrows.

name: Pierce Coating
desc: A coating that increases piercing ability. Depending on the monster, it can deal multiple hits.

name: Paralysis Coating
desc: A coating that applies paralysis effects to arrows.

name: Poison Coating
desc: A coating that applies poison effects to arrows.

name: Sleep Coating
desc: A coating that applies sleep effects to arrows.

name: Blast Coating
desc: A coating that applies explosive powder to arrows.

name: Exhaust Coating
desc: A coating that applies a fluid which induces exhaust to arrows.

name: Whetfish Fin+
desc: A fish fin used to sharpen weapons. Works better than a whetstone and can be reused if you're lucky.

name: Great Sushifish Scale
desc: Scale from a Sushifish. Eat to get a large health/natural healing boost or to treat bleeding.

name: Old Weapon Shard - Blade
desc: A piece of a discarded, old blade. Needs to be appraised.

name: Old Weapon Shard - Tube
desc: A cylindrical part of an old weapon that's been thrown away. Needs to be appraised.

name: Old Weapon Shard - Disc
desc: A disc-like part of an old weapon that's been thrown away. Needs to be appraised.

name: Old Weapon Shard - Device
desc: A part of an old weapon that has some sort of device on it. Needs to be appraised.

name: <COLOR FF0000>#Rejected#</COLOR> Item_IT_690
desc: <COLOR FF0000>#Rejected#</COLOR> Item_IT_EXP_690

name: Gracium
desc: Precious ore from the Iceshard Cliffs. Swathed in frigid air that shines pale blue when the light catches it.

name: Wyverian Bloodstone Shard
desc: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

name: Wyverian Bloodstone (S)
desc: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

name: Wyverian Bloodstone
desc: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

name: Wyverian Bloodstone (L)
desc: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Larger than most of its type. Can be used as a melding material.

name: Wyverian Bloodstone Chunk
desc: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. One of the largest of its kind. Can be used as a melding material.

name: Balahara Black Pearl
desc: A jewel formed from ore that spent years inside a Balahara. Bewitchingly beautiful.

name: Guardian Rathalos Ruby
desc: A rare jewel that developed in a Guardian Rathalos' body. Said to wield the power of an inferno.

name: Guardian Rathalos Plate
desc: A plate from a Guardian Rathalos. Strengthened by the flow of energy, its inherent heat blazes forth.

name: Jin Dahaad Tail
desc: The tail of a Jin Dahaad. Has a cooling organ that continues to make cold air even when severed.

name: Expedition Headgear Ticket
desc: A ticket inscribed with the emblem of the expedition. Give it to the Smithy to get special equipment.
